messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted API cluster us-west-2 - p99 latency > 12s, request queue growth detected (>200k backlog). Auto-escalation to #incidents, paging infra-oncall and SREs :rotating_light:
Samira Qureshi: I'm on it, pulling dashboards now. seeing sustained enqueue, GPUs at 99% util across the primary pool.
Alice Chen: Paging details? which autoscaler?
Miguel Torres: This is the gpu-provisioner-autoscaler (v2). Metrics show scale attempts stuck, lots of 429s from cloud provider when creating new instances.
Priya Patel: Confirming customer impact: some gen endpoints returning 504s for >10% of requests, p95 spiking to ~8s. Noticing timeouts from AcmeCorp and BetaHealth test traffic.
Kiran Rao: I can take provisioner logs. Running `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/gpu-provisioner -f --tail=200`
ops-bot: @Kiran Rao linked logs: https://logs.example/infra/provisioner/1777771234
Kiran Rao: log snippet: `2026-03-15T16:02:03Z ERROR createInstance: quotaExceeded: instances.unavailable -> 429`
Samira Qureshi: Autoscaler maxNodes is 120, current nodes 119. The cluster is hitting a per-account vCPU/GPU quota at the cloud level.
Alice Chen: Are there any immediate fallbacks? Can we route non-critical traffic to the small-quantized replica pool or to Dedicated?
Miguel Torres: Routing requires changing routing rules; we can flip a traffic-rule to send low-priority routes to a slower model variant or to dedicated if capacity available. Need a quick toggle.
Priya Patel: Suggest: 1) enable reject/shape (shed) for free-tier and background jobs, 2) route premium customer traffic to dedicated pools, 3) try manual node creation via cloud console to bypass autoscaler throttling.
Samira Qureshi: Agreed. Assigning tasks: @Kiran - attempt manual instance create, @Miguel - prepare routing rule change, @Alice - coordinate customer comms, @Priya - open quota escalation with cloud support.
Kiran Rao: Running manual create: `gcloud compute instances create gpu-worker-1777 --zone=us-west2-a --accelerator=count=1,type=nvidia-t4`
Kiran Rao: Response: `ERROR: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 12345 in region us-west2`
Kiran Rao: Cloud account-level quota is blocking manual create.
Miguel Torres: Ok routing plan: update edge-route `route: /v1/generate` add header-based split: `x-priority: high` -> primary, else -> quantized-llm-2. Patch ready, will roll in 30s.
ops-bot: Deploy request submitted: `infra/edge-config#452` by Miguel Torres. CI passed.
Miguel Torres: Patch applied. Monitoring traffic shift now.
Samira Qureshi: Observing immediate drop in primary queue by ~40k over 2 minutes. p99 falls from 12s -> 6.5s. Good.
Priya Patel: Cloud support ticket created: INC-9981, requesting quota bump for GPUs in us-west2, note: high-severity production outage. ETA unknown.
Alice Chen: Customer comms draft: "We're experiencing elevated latency due to capacity limits; routing non-critical requests to fallback models. Premium traffic prioritized. We're mitigating and will update in 30m." Send after I post a status page entry.
Samira Qureshi: Reminder: we're seeing two issues in parallel: provider quota blocking new GPUs + autoscaler backlog (scale decisions still pending). Need longer-term: increase quota and increase autoscaler maxNodes or enable cross-region fallback.
Kiran Rao: Provisioner pods showed repeated `rate_limit_exceeded` on cloud API. I'm restarting provisioner to clear any stalled create loops: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/gpu-provisioner`
Kiran Rao: Restart done. Provisioner logs now show: `200 OK` for some calls but still `quotaExceeded` in region.
Miguel Torres: After routing toggle, some customers (AcmeCorp) report restored performance. BetaHealth still seeing intermittent 504s - their traffic is mostly low-priority test jobs and got routed; need to follow up.
Priya Patel: Short term mitigation checklist completed: routing split applied, provisioner restarted, cloud support engaged, status page posted.
Samira Qureshi: Additional mitigation: enable temporary per-API request rate-limit for anonymous tokens to reduce noisy bursts. Miguel, can you flip that?
Miguel Torres: Applying header-based rate-limit rule now: `rate_limit(anonymous): 5r/s` -> applied.
ops-bot: Rate limit rule change rolled by Miguel Torres at 2026-03-15T16:28:12Z.
Samira Qureshi: Monitoring: queue now steadying at ~60k backlog (was 200k). p99 trending down to ~3.2s. GPU utilization still high but not saturating.
Alice Chen: I'm posting to customers: AcmeCorp notified, BetaHealth aware. Draft sent to #customer-updates for review.
Priya Patel: Postmortem action items being recorded: 1) request cross-region fallback automation, 2) set dynamic quota buffer alert, 3) increase autoscaler maxNodes to 200 behind feature flag, 4) improve routed-fallback playbook.
Kiran Rao: Follow-up: need to implement exponential backoff in provisioner create loop to avoid hammering cloud API when quotas are low. Filed task INFRA-821.
Samira Qureshi: Current status: mitigations in place, partial recovery, on-call monitoring for 2 hours. Reassigning incident lead to Alice for customer comms and follow-up.
Alice Chen: Taking lead. Thanks everyone. I'll run a quick post-incident triage in 90m and schedule a follow-up with cloud provider.
incident-bot: Incident timeline update saved to https://incidents.example/1777771234. Incident state: mitigating -> monitoring.
